audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts give Akshan the lane through level 5 while their own whys say Garen takes over from level 2. The packet chart is Akshan/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill and Garen wins 53.27% over 2692 games. The full layer additionally sits at TRICKY 7/10 for a lane Garen wins.
audit.why: Four rows in content and four in full argued against the text printed on the same row. A reader following the chart concedes exactly the stages this matchup says to fight in.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one group in both layers: Akshan at 1, Garen levels 2 through first item, skill check at two items. diff to EVEN, diffRating to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike calls Comeuppance a 'stacking execute' and gives no cooldown anywhere on the page. Riot's text says it locks on, stores bullets, and deals damage based on missing health — it is not an execute, and it is 100/85/70 seconds.
audit.why: The distinction changes behaviour: against a missing-health ability you stay topped up, against an execute you stay above a threshold. And a 100-second rank-1 cooldown is the single largest fight window in the lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now states missing-health scaling and the 100s rank-1 cooldown, and keeps the Q-silence into R answer if he commits at melee range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) Three fields say Avengerang heals him on its return — Riot's text gives it no healing at all; the sustain-shaped effect is Dirty Fighting (P), which shields him every third hit from attacks and abilities. (b) wants.you[1] says the silence cancels his passive shield procs; Dirty Fighting procs off basic attacks, which a silence does not stop.
audit.why: Two of these are pure inventions of an effect that is not in the kit, and the third tells the reader a silence does something it cannot do.
audit.corrected: Heal replaced with the real effect — Avengerang damages going out and coming back and every third hit shields him. The silence advice is re-keyed to what it actually buys: Avengerang holstered for its 9s rank-1 cooldown, and stepping in only once Heroic Swing is on its 18s rank-1 cooldown.
sources: champ-data/_kits/akshan.json P text, Q text and cd 9/8/7/6/5, E cd 18/16.5/15/13.5/12

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice on this matchup — no 'wait for X before you Y' line existed anywhere.
audit.why: Every green light in this lane is a cooldown: Heroic Swing needs terrain to grapple, and once it is spent he has no way out of a Q-slow run-down.
audit.corrected: mid now says to fight him in open lane where there is no terrain to swing off, with Heroic Swing's 18s rank-1 cooldown as the trigger; wants.you[1] carries the same trigger.
sources: champ-data/_kits/akshan.json E text 'fires a grappling hook into terrain'
